whatIsIt.eli5: A few learned numbers that turn each layer of notes up or down.
whatIsIt.simple: A free learned vector, e.g. A2C2f's gamma (one value per channel, starting at 0.01) that scales the block output before the residual add.

whyExists.eli5: To let the block start gently.
whyExists.simple: Starting near zero makes the residual block nearly an identity at first, which stabilises training.
whyExists.engineer: Layer scale (CaiT-style) for deep attention stacks.

eli5: Multiply each layer by its own number.
